name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
summary: Tundra MacGrann needs his winter stores back from Old Icebeard. The yeti carried off the thorium-reinforced meat locker, and MacGrann's injured leg keeps him from reaching the cave.

sections.title: Winter Stores and Stolen Lockers
sections.body: For the cold season, MacGrann had salted away a month's worth of dried meat. He sealed it in a thorium-reinforced locker to keep hungry bears out. Old Icebeard carried off the whole chest instead of trying to open it.

sections.title: Old Icebeard's Den
sections.body: While MacGrann was away hunting deer, Old Icebeard dragged the chest to a cave in the jagged hills. MacGrann believes the yeti cannot break through solid thorium, but his injured leg keeps him from retrieving the stores. You can face the beast or slip inside while it prowls the snowdrifts.

faq.answer: Tundra MacGrann is a dwarven hunter who lives in the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh. His injured leg leaves him reliant on his stored provisions for winter.
Old Icebeard, a local yeti, stole MacGrann's meat locker while the hunter was away hunting deer. The beast dragged it into its mountain cave.

faq.q: Why can't MacGrann get his meats back himself?
faq.answer: MacGrann's injured leg keeps him from moving quickly or quietly enough to enter Old Icebeard's cave and escape safely.

faq.q: Did the yeti eat the food?
faq.answer: No. The dried meat remains locked inside a solid thorium chest. Old Icebeard carried it away but cannot break through the metal.

faq.q: Do you have to fight Old Icebeard to get the meat locker?
aliases: do i have to kill icebeard
faq.answer: You can slip into the cave while Old Icebeard is out prowling and retrieve the locker without fighting him.

faq.q: Where is the stolen stash located?
faq.answer: The stolen meat locker is deep inside Old Icebeard's mountain cave, in the hills near MacGrann's camp in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a hunter, you know how much work it takes to preserve meat. MacGrann lost his stores to a beast while he was out tracking deer.
As a dwarf, you know how harsh a mountain winter can be. Without preserved meat or shelter, even a seasoned mountaineer may not withstand the cold.
As a rogue, you can slip into Old Icebeard's cave while he is away and take the locker without drawing a blade.
